messages:
Maya: Heads-up — nightly perf CI flagged a p95 spike on small-batch 'bench-arnold-8'. ~2.5x above baseline. Attaching a short log excerpt.
CI-bot: ALERT: nightly-ci/bench-arnold-8 p95 latency 2.5x above baseline. Runs window: 1755554200-1755554300. Report: https://ci/reports/1755554321
Samir: Can someone grab the flame/profile and stack traces? @Alex did you touch the batching gate yesterday?
Alex: I merged a batching heuristic tweak (PR #5031) last night that touched request router coalescing. I'll start a bisect.
DevOps: I can repro locally if you paste the exact bench command. I'll also check kernel tunables / context-switch stats on the node.
Maya: bench cmd: `scripts/run_bench --suite arnold-8 --batch-size 4 --reps 30 --profile`. Logs: https://logs/175555/arnold-8. Snippet:
```
ERROR: p95 320ms vs baseline 120ms
alloc histogram: hot path in request_router::try_coalesce
```
Alex: Bisect plan: revert the batching gate change from PR #5031 in a canary, run the same bench. Cmd I use: `git revert <sha-5031> && make bench && ./scripts/run_bench --suite arnold-8 --batch-size 4 --reps 30`
CI-bot: Job queued: night-bench-canary-17555545. ETA ~12m.
Maya: :eyes: ping @DevOps if you want me to snapshot the node before canary.
DevOps: Yes please, snapshot and I'll `sudo perf record -a -g` during the canary and upload perf data. Also grabbing `/proc/sys/kernel/sched_*` values.
Alex: Canary ran — revert looks promising. Revert run p95=125ms, main p95=320ms. Reverting the PR brings numbers back near baseline.
Samir: Great. Can we get a diff flame/main vs flame/revert? Also check kv-cache hit-rate; that could explain extra backend work.
Maya: Flame diff uploaded: https://perf/175555/flame-diff.html — shows hot in `request_router::try_coalesce` and increased allocator time.
DevOps: Metrics show kv-cache hit-rate dropped ~7% after PR #5031. That will amplify downstream time.
Jordan: PR #5031 tightened coalescing to reduce latency in some cases but looks like it caused more allocations and worse cache behaviour.
Alex: Opening rollback PR #5042 to revert the heuristic. Requesting rapid canary deploy to the dedicated pool so we can confirm across traffic.
Maya: If rollback is risky, fallback option: enable routing to the pre-quantized model variant for the affected route until we fix heuristics. I can stage the runbook steps.
CI-bot: Status updated: escalated -> ops. Runbook: /runbooks/nightly-p95-spike.
DevOps: :thumbsup: I'll standby to run the canary deploy and watch perf dashboards. Alex, please add deployment notes to the PR.
Samir: Also add a small perf unit test for the mini-batch allocation path so this doesn't regress silently.
Alex: Will add test and brief notes to PR #5042, pushing now. Thanks for the fast triage. I'll follow up on rollback deployment.
Maya: Follow-ups I'm opening: (1) ticket for rollback + canary, (2) perf unit test task, (3) alert rule tweak to include kv-cache hit-rate drops. I'll link tickets here.
CI-bot: Alert cleared on main after canary deploy and rollback. Resolved. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks team — looping back if anything else pops up.
